verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official server-side SDK, `@airwallex/node-sdk`, a TypeScript-first package for its platform APIs. It offers strongly typed request and response models, built-in error handling, automatic retries, token refresh and support for custom requests. The SDK program is explicitly labeled beta, which is a significant caveat for building against it. Missing for 10: GA (non-beta) status, evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond Node.js/TypeScript, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
